controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:40:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:40:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
        AND event.outcome == "success"
        AND message LIKE "*Accepted*"
| KEEP @timestamp, source.ip, user.name, message
| SORT @timestamp ASC
| LIMIT 100
